decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed included many items that were not actually backpacks (umbrellas, towels, cooking pots, lanterns). Within the backpack category, I selected a range of options: a large internal frame pack (High Sierra 70L), a tactical mid-size pack (Seibertron 37L), a budget-friendly daypack (SHENHU 40L), a packable travel bag (ZOMAKE), and a hydration pack (Sojourner). The High Sierra Pathway 70L was the final choice because it offers excellent value for a technical hiking pack with a 4.7 rating and comprehensive features like an internal frame and breathable mesh, which justifies the higher price compared to the budget daypacks.
